Class ClientModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.client.model.ClientModel
public class ClientModel extends Object
Client-side model for the Galaxy Truckers game. This class manages game state, player information, and ship data on the client side. It implements the Observer pattern to notify view components of model changes. Thread safety is maintained through strategic synchronization.
